assumptions.statement: Printer/material lifecycle reviews remain unverified synthetic declarations; no applicable OEM, material-grade or slicer-profile evidence is established.
Job orientation/support reviewed flags, slicer verified flag and any environment known label lack supporting job-specific review records; they cannot authorize manufacture.

Partial mesh/package checks and independent geometry exports do not establish self-intersection/fill correctness, functional design intent, usable-bed/support clearance, a verified sliced build or qualified approval.
A parseable Core package with a small build envelope does not establish a complete additive job or applicable profile/environment review.

verification.summary: File-derived partial evidence only; profile, intent, slicer, orientation/support, environment and qualified review are unresolved.

simulation.reason: Applicable slicer/layer-preview and build verification has not been performed for this job; native geometry import/export is not that evidence.
required_checks: Confirm source intent, units, revision and the exact mesh/package including unresolved geometry semantics
Review applicable printer/material/slicer configuration, build placement, orientation/support and usable-bed clearances
Verify the resulting sliced build and record limitations against the same reviewed inputs and qualified environmental/operator context

human_review.action: Preserve the package's whole-file hash and explicit/default unit provenance; obtain applicable printer/material/slicer and job-context evidence, review geometry and intended product requirements, then verify and approve the exact sliced build through qualified review. Resolve all unchanged baseline evidence gaps. Do not print from this packet.
human_review.reviewer_role: Qualified design authority, additive process/profile reviewer and responsible site/operator reviewer
